tools.description: Adds or changes details on a quote: people, drivers, vehicles, the property, coverages, discounts, prior insurance, and policy terms. The patch schema lists every field Libertas accepts. Safe to call repeatedly; the latest value for a field wins, and lists replace earlier lists. Returns which fields

tools.name: get_quote_options
tools.description: Starts rating with Libertas's panel of A-rated carriers and returns right away. First prices usually arrive within 30-90 seconds as honest ranges (the low end is the carrier's own preliminary figure). Libertas then keeps working for 2-10 minutes to capture exact, bindable rates directly from carrier

tools.description:

  - running: prices are still arriving; check again in a turn or two.
  - quoted: options are ready. While finishing.active is true, Libertas is still capturing exact rates, so ranges are estimates (the final number ma

tools.name: get_option_details
tools.description: Returns the coverage breakdown, deductibles, discounts applied, and payment plans for one option (for example opt_home_a), so the customer can compare before choosing. The carrier stays masked as 'Carrier A-Home' and so on.

tools.name: get_bind_link
tools.description: Emails the customer a single-use secure link (valid 7 days) to Libertas's bind page, where they review the chosen option, see the carrier's name, and submit their request; a licensed agent completes the purchase. Uses the email address already on the quote and reports whether it was sent; no text me

tools.name: request_bind_inline
tools.description: Sends the customer's chosen option(s) to Libertas's licensed team as a bind request and returns a secure checkout link on Libertas's site. This is a request, not a purchase: no payment is taken and no coverage starts from this call. A licensed agent verifies underwriting, collects payment on the sec

tools.name: check_late_arrivals
tools.description: Checks whether a slower carrier has come back with a better price since the options were first shown. has_improvement is true only when a new rate beats the earlier best by at least $100 a year or 5%. Useful when the customer hesitates over price after seeing options. If nothing improved, it's best

tools.name: submit_lead
tools.description: Asks a licensed Libertas agent to follow up with the customer: for insurance Libertas doesn't quote in chat (renters, condo, landlord, umbrella, life, commercial, motorcycle, boat, RV, and more), or when a home/auto customer would rather talk to someone later. tools.name: resume_quote
tools.description: Looks up a quote started earlier, by its quote_id. Returns the quote's status, whether options are ready, and what's still needed. Saved personal details are returned only to the same platform user who started the quote.

tools.name: stop_contact
tools.description: Records that the customer doesn't want Libertas to contact them by phone call, text, email, or any of these. Appropriate whenever the customer asks, in any wording, to stop hearing from Libertas; Libertas honors it across its follow-up systems. Pass the quote_id when there is one, or the email and/o

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.quotor.ai" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_quote_status, get_bind_link · Private data: update_quote, submit_lead, stop_contact · Public sink: start_quote, check_quote_status, get_bind_link, submit_lead, stop_contact · Destructive: update_quote, get_quote_options, check_quote_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_quote_status, get_bind_link · Private data: update_quote, submit_lead, stop_contact · Public sink: start_quote, check_quote_status, get_bind_link, submit_lead, stop_contact · Destructive: update_quote, get_quote_options, check_quote_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_quote_status" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
